title: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan to visit Andhra Pradesh on November 13
subtitle: Vice-President to address the Valedictory Session of the 31st CII Partnership Summit
body_text: The Vice-President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, will visit Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, on November 13, 2026. During the visit, the Vice-President will address the Valedictory Session of the 31st edition of the CII Partnership Summit. ****** PR/ASM/VMJ
